proposals.title: Re-attempt monorepo bootstrap using npm workspaces to eliminate the pnpm resolution blocker
proposals.why_now: TASK-0001 has been attempted twice and rejected both times. The authoritative validation environment resolves the pnpm command to /workspace/pnpm (the directory), not the pnpm binary; both implementers reported all local commands green, but the authoritative checker cannot reproduce those results. Switching to npm workspaces removes the single root cause of all execution failures. Review-02 also raised a second blocker: tsconfig include patterns cover only .ts, silently excluding .tsx/.mts/.cts from compilation. Both issues must be fixed before any FASE-1 acceptance criterion can be verified. The repository has zero committed production code after 15 cycles; this task is the absolute prerequisite for everything else.

proposals.title: Write ADR-002 (hash function), ADR-004 (rounding enforcement), and ADR-009 (CanonicalEncoder) before packages/core is implemented
proposals.why_now: All three ADRs are explicit prerequisites before any implementation may begin: §15 FASE-1 states ADR-009 must be written and the encoder implemented before any state hash exists; ADR-002 requires the hash function specified bit-by-bit in an ADR before any rand() implementation; ADR-004 marks the technical mechanism for enforcing rounding-mode declaration as DEFINIR. Implementing packages/core without these ADRs embeds unrecorded decisions that cannot be reversed without an encodingVersion bump and invalidation of all frozen reference StateHashes. These documents can be authored in parallel with IDEA-001's monorepo fix since they touch only docs/decisions/.

proposals.title: packages/core — branded numeric types, positional RNG, division helpers, and CanonicalEncoder
proposals.why_now: packages/core is the dependency of every other pure package. Without branded types (Money, Quantity, Price, Rate as bigint; Tick and noise indices as number restricted to safe integers), the type system cannot enforce ADR-003 or ADR-004 and violations accumulate silently from the first file. Without the positional rand() implementing the algorithm from ADR-002, packages/world cannot be written. Without CanonicalEncoder implementing ADR-009, no StateHash can be computed and INV-01, INV-17, INV-22 have no foundation. This is the second foundational step after the monorepo and ADRs.

proposals.title: packages/world price generator, packages/domain ledger and market orders, packages/application canonical tick loop
proposals.why_now: These three packages compose the functional core of FASE-1. The price generator delivers INV-02 (the most important test in the project per the spec). The double-entry ledger delivers INV-04 through INV-07. The canonical tick loop implements the ten-step locked order from §7, which is a FASE-1 acceptance criterion. application is the only layer that composes world and domain without coupling them; none of the invariants can be fully verified in isolation — they become testable only when composed through application. This work must follow IDEA-003 and must resolve the DEFINIR for transcendental functions in log-space price construction before implementation begins.

proposals.title: tools/replay, tools/bench, and minimum Electron UI to complete FASE-1 acceptance
proposals.why_now: FASE-1 acceptance requires tools/replay reporting the first divergent tick, tools/bench with frozen calibration ratios, a minimum UI (lightweight-charts price chart, BRL balance, buy/sell buttons, pause/1x controls), and the permanent non-dismissable disclaimer from §20. The performance baseline must be frozen in FASE-1 — deferring it means the bench gate has no reference for the rest of the project. The installers must also exist in FASE-1 in minimum form, because deferred packaging leads to ABI and module-native failures that are not correctable locally once architecture is established.

repository_assessment.current_state: Repository contains only benchmark scaffolding (spec copy, benchmark history, checkpoint files). No production source code exists: no package.json, no workspace configuration, no packages/ or apps/ or tools/ directories, no ADRs under docs/decisions/, no CI pipeline. All three checkpoints report internal_commit_count=0 and NO_ACCEPTED_CHANGES. TASK-0001 (monorepo bootstrap) was created in CYCLE-000011 and has been attempted twice; both attempts failed review. Attempt-01 failed for four reasons including .mts/.cts exclusions from the pure-lint gate, boundary gate using transitive closure instead of direct edges, and pnpm not found in the authoritative validation environment. Attempt-02 fixed the lint and boundary issues but the authoritative environment still failed to resolve the pnpm binary (resolves to /workspace/pnpm directory), and a new finding emerged: TypeScript project include patterns silently excluded .tsx/.mts/.cts from compilation. No active task at the start of CYCLE-000015.
repository_assessment.highest_priority_gap: The monorepo does not exist. The single blocker preventing TASK-0001 acceptance across two attempts is that the authoritative validation environment cannot resolve the pnpm binary — it resolves to /workspace/pnpm (the directory) instead of the package manager. Switching to npm workspaces eliminates this root cause. A second concrete gap is that TypeScript project include patterns must be changed to cover all four supported source extensions (.ts, .tsx, .mts, .cts) so no source file is silently excluded from compilation. Until both are resolved, no gate can be verified and no FASE-1 criterion can be met.

warnings: SYSTEMIC PROCESS FAILURE: As of CYCLE-000015 the repository has zero accepted commits after approximately 4520 seconds of active benchmark runtime and at least 15 ideation cycles. TASK-0001 has been through two full implementation-review cycles with no acceptance. The blocking issue is environmental: the authoritative validator resolves pnpm to /workspace/pnpm (a directory), not the package manager binary. Implementers report all local commands green but cannot reproduce a green result in the authoritative environment. The fix is to use npm workspaces (dropping pnpm entirely) so the root commands run with a universally available binary.

DEFINIR BLOCKER — transcendental functions for price generation: §5.1 constructs prices in log-space, requiring Math.log and Math.exp. Both are prohibited in pure packages by §13. An ADR specifying fixed-point or lookup-table implementations producing bit-identical results across platforms must be written before packages/world can be implemented. This ADR is separate from ADR-002, ADR-004, and ADR-009 and has not yet been proposed as a standalone deliverable.

DEFINIR BLOCKER — octave parameters: the number of octaves, periods, and amplitudes for trendLayer and idiosyncraticNoise are DEFINIR per §5.1 and must be fixed in a versioned configuration file with an ADR before the price generator is implemented, because any post-implementation change requires an encodingVersion bump and invalidates all reference StateHashes frozen in tools/bench.

DEFINIR BLOCKER — tools/* dependency edges: §14.5 defines edges for packages and apps but not for tools/*. tools/replay and tools/bench will need to import from packages to fulfill FASE-1 acceptance items. An ADR or SPEC_BLOCKERS.md entry is required before those tools acquire cross-workspace imports.
